services.desc: Our beautiful arts & culture center serves as the perfect backdrop to your corporate event! From 3 to 300, there are rooms of various sizes to gather together as a group or separate out into break-out spaces amidst the backdrop of our arts center. We’ve got chairs, tables, a stage, and A/V equipment ready to help you support the goals of your event.
